**Ores of a mod's blocks, a 512-block view distance with a soft edge, a lighter Mac app**

Edit ▸ Ores lays ores of any block, a mod's tin or silver ore as well as the game's: **+ ▸ Ore of any block…** searches the blocks of the game and of the mods and packs Game & mods… has read, finds its deepslate block as the game names its own (or keeps the same block), and lays it in veins like the game's ores, with its own bands, sizes and biomes; the cut, the amounts and the survival check count it, and it is saved with the map (maps without one export exactly as before). Settings ▸ Graphics offers a **View distance** of 512 blocks for slower computers, and with Fog on the land now fades into the haze toward the view distance instead of ending at an edge, in the 3D View and the player's view alike. The macOS download is about 48 MB lighter: Open Image Denoise, the Render side's denoiser, now ships for Apple silicon only; Macs with an Intel chip denoise with the Render side's own filter on the graphics card (or Blender's copy of Open Image Denoise, when Blender is installed).
